335	```js

341	### Step 1 — build the class pattern (one char per argv token)

343	```
344	pattern = []; sawDashDash = false;
345	for (i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
346	  if (args[i] === '--') { pattern.push('-'); for (j=i+1;j<args.length;j++) pattern.push('A'); break; }
347	  const t = classify(args[i]);            // may raise the ambiguous-option error
348	  pattern.push(t === null ? 'A' : 'O');
349	  tokens[i] = t;                          // null == value, else {action|null, optString, sep, explicitArg}

356	```

358	if (s[0] !== '-')              return null;                 // value
359	if (KNOWN.has(s))              return {action:KNOWN.get(s), optString:s, sep:null, explicitArg:null};
360	if (s.length === 1)            return null;                 // bare "-"
361	if (s.includes('=')) {
362	   const i = s.indexOf('='), head = s.slice(0,i), tail = s.slice(i+1);
363	   if (KNOWN.has(head))        return {action:KNOWN.get(head), optString:head, sep:'=', explicitArg:tail};
364	}
365	const tups = getOptionTuples(s);
366	if (tups.length > 1)  ERROR2(`ambiguous option: ${s} could match ${tups.map(t=>t.optString).join(', ')}`);
367	if (tups.length === 1) return tups[0];
368	if (NEGNUM.test(s))            return null;                 // value  (Unicode Nd!)
369	if (s.includes(' '))           return null;                 // value
370	return {action:null, optString:s, sep:null, explicitArg:null};   // unknown option -> extras

375	```
376	const out = [];
377	if (s.length > 1 && s[1] === '-') {                  // long form
378	  let prefix = s, expl = null, sep = null;
379	  const i = s.indexOf('=');
380	  if (i !== -1) { prefix = s.slice(0,i); expl = s.slice(i+1); sep = '='; }
381	  for (const [o, act] of KNOWN)                      // order: -h, --help, --a
382	    if (o.startsWith(prefix)) out.push({action:act, optString:o, sep, explicitArg:expl});

384	  const short = s.slice(0,2), shortExpl = s.slice(2);
385	  for (const [o, act] of KNOWN) {
386	    if (o === short)             out.push({action:act, optString:o, sep:'',   explicitArg:shortExpl});

389	}

## 4. STRING / BYTES / numeric repr

### 4.1 Algorithm (verified complete)
1. `bytes` gets a leading `b`.
2. Delimiter `'` by default; `"` iff the value contains `'` **and not** `"`. `"` is **never** escaped. `'` escaped as `\'` only when the delimiter is `'`.
3. `\` → `\\`.
4. `\t`(09)→`\t`, `\n`(0a)→`\n`, `\r`(0d)→`\r`. **No `\a \b \f \v \0` shorthands.**
5. `bytes`: 0x20–0x7e literal; **all** of 0x00–0x1f and 0x7f–0xff → `\xHH` (lowercase, 2 digits).
6. `str`: escape iff `str.isprintable()` is false — categories {Cc, Cf, Cs, Co, Cn, Zl, Zp, Zs}, with U+0020 the sole printable exception. Widths: cp<0x100 → `\xHH`; <0x10000 → `\uHHHH`; else `\UHHHHHHHH`. Lowercase hex, fixed width, **never** disambiguated against a following hex-looking char (`'\x001'`, `'\x1b5b'`, `'\u200bf00'`, `b'\x001'`).
7. Everything else raw UTF-8: Mn/Me combining marks, So, Sk, variation selectors U+FE00–FE0F, emoji, CJK, U+FFFD, U+00A1–AC, U+00AE–FF.

## 7. OTHER DIVERGENCE RISKS FOR A JS PORT

- **Exit codes**: 0 success / help; 1 unhandled Python exception (traceback + `[PYI-…]`); 2 any argparse error (no `[PYI-…]`); **120** stdout/stderr write failure during shutdown flush (`--help >/dev/full`, `--help | head -c 0`, `2>/dev/full`); 124 only from an external `timeout` on the infinite-iterator hang.
- **Buffering / stream order**: TTY → line-buffered, chronological (verified under `script -qec`). Pipe or file → stdout block-buffered and flushed at interpreter shutdown, so with `2>&1` the **whole traceback (and SyntaxWarning) precedes all stdout lines**. Verbatim example: traceback, `[PYI-15191:ERROR] …`, then `[None]`, `[[None]]`, `[[None]]`.
- **Streams**: help → stdout; every argparse error, traceback and SyntaxWarning → stderr. Both are `TextIOWrapper(encoding='utf-8', errors='surrogateescape')` (proved by `Exception ignored in: <_io.TextIOWrapper name='<stdout>' mode='w' encoding='utf-8'>`). LF only, no BOM, no trailing whitespace, every line LF-terminated.
- **Encoding is immovable**: `PYTHONIOENCODING=ascii`, `ascii:backslashreplace`, `latin-1`, `LC_ALL=C`, `LANG=C`, `LC_ALL=zh_CN.UTF-8`, `LANGUAGE=de` all byte-identical. Ambient locale is `LANG=` / `LC_*=POSIX`. Messages are never translated. `errors='surrogateescape'` is reachable: a repr returning `chr(0xdcff)` writes raw byte `0xFF` (exit 0); `chr(0xd800)` raises UnicodeEncodeError at the print (exit 1).
- **Line count is not always 5**: crash counts 0–4 reachable; a `__repr__` containing `\n` yields more than 5 lines at exit 0.
- **Nondeterministic** (cannot be reproduced): `[PYI-<pid>]`, `0xADDR` in object/function reprs, `_MEIxxxxxx` in `__file__`/module reprs, `sys.version` build date, str/bytes-keyed set iteration order.
- Determinism otherwise confirmed: 3 identical runs of `[1,[2,[3,4]],5]` → identical stdout, md5 `9caa9205c14758b02cad279791d0e565`.
- **Probing hygiene warning carried in the file**: reusing a `/tmp` capture filename in this sandbox produced impossible captures (exit 0 + argparse error text glued together) because a short write does not truncate. Use a unique filename per probe — do not treat such captures as real behavior.
